findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_paid_products, get_discovery_urls · Private data: execute_paid_product · Public sink: build_purchase_request · Destructive: execute_paid_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_paid_products, get_discovery_urls · Private data: execute_paid_product · Public sink: build_purchase_request · Destructive: execute_paid_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
